title: Service request procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of a secure connection to the network for data transfer or signaling.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Network response message indicating service request cannot be accepted, containing 5GMM cause value.

entities.name: 5GMM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating reason for service request rejection.

entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: IE indicating which PDU sessions are active in AMF, used for session status synchronization.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: Information element containing Closed Access Group information for access control.

entities.name: Extended CAG information list
entities.description: Extended version of CAG information list for UEs supporting extended CAG capabilities.

entities.name: Disaster return wait range
entities.description: IE indicating waiting period before UE can return after disaster condition.

entities.name: T3346
entities.description: Back-off timer for general NAS level mobility management congestion control.

entities.name: T3448
entities.description: Control plane data back-off timer for CIoT optimizations.

entities.name: T3517
entities.description: Service request procedure timer stopped upon SERVICE REJECT reception.

entities.name: 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state when service request procedure has been initiated.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state when not registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state when registered with the network.

entities.name: Integrity protected message
entities.description: Condition where NAS message has been integrity protected by security mechanisms.

entities.name: Local PDU session release
entities.description: UE behavior to locally release PDU sessions based on network indication.

relations.description: Service request procedure includes network sending SERVICE REJECT when not accepted.
SERVICE REJECT message contains 5GMM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
SERVICE REJECT may contain PDU session status IE for session synchronization.
SERVICE REJECT may contain CAG information list IE for CAG-related rejections.
SERVICE REJECT may contain Extended CAG information list IE for UEs supporting extended CAG.
SERVICE REJECT may contain Disaster return wait range IE for MINT scenarios.
SERVICE REJECT with cause #22 starts T3346 timer for congestion control.
SERVICE REJECT with cause #22 starts T3448 timer for control plane data congestion.
UE stops T3517 timer upon receiving SERVICE REJECT in 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
SERVICE REJECT reception requires UE to be in 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
SERVICE REJECT with PDU session status IE establishes local PDU session release behavior.
Local PDU session release is guarded by SERVICE REJECT being integrity protected.
T3346 timer value usage is guarded by SERVICE REJECT integrity protection status.
T3448 timer value usage is guarded by SERVICE REJECT integrity protection status.
SERVICE REJECT causes UE transition to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for certain cause values.
SERVICE REJECT causes UE transition to 5GMM-REGISTERED state for certain cause values.
